purpose: Behavior-preserving extraction: compare every 3-tick decision on the same legal observation, alternating which frozen implementation actually controls the subject

decision.budget: 24 complete-game starts, 12 driven by each implementation; all actual games remain unseeded
decision.acceptance: Every compared intent must match exactly, with zero shadow submissions. Preserve and stop on the first mismatch. New controller-driven games must end normally. This checks covered trajectories, not equivalence of every possible state or improved strength.
decision.timing: Record isolated old/new decision-call cost on identical observations, alternating call order. Full match time includes shadow and logging overhead and is not a production-throughput comparison.
